description: To develop ultra-high energy density battery cells with specific energy of 500 Wh / kg (e.g. Lithium sulphur, Lithium-metal anode etc).Description: Deep space missions demand energy storage solutions that significantly outperform current state-of-the-art technologies in terms of specific energy density, reliability and resilience under extreme environmental conditions. As missions move beyond the Earth orbit toward the Moon, Mars and beyond, spacecraft must operate autonomously for extended periods without the possibility of recharge or maintenance. This requires batteries with ultra-high energy density, that can maximize the mission duration and system efficiency, whilst minimizing the mass of the units. These batteries must also withstand vacuum, a high temperature range and radiation conditions. The development of high specific energy battery cells is an asset to reduce the mass and volume of the battery units. This activity focusses on defining an ultra-high energy density battery cell chemistry. Upon selected chemistry it develops abreadboard of a battery. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Technology survey and selection: Review and assess emerging battery chemistries and architectures with the highest potential for space applications. Select the most promising candidates forfurther development. - Material and cell development: Develop and optimize materials and electrochemical cells that meet the defined requirements, including electrodes, novel electrolytes, and the design of ultra-high energy density cell formats. - Prototype designand assembly: Design, manufacture and assemble a cell or battery prototype. Emphasis should be placed on minimizing the final mass,while enhancing safety and durability. - Performance testing and validation: Perform environmental and performance testing, including thermal cycling, vacuum exposure, vibration, life-tests and radiation tolerance, to validate the operational readiness of the developed cells. - Roadmap and industrialization strategy: Develop a roadmap for technology maturation and space qualification. Conditiile legale de securitate pentru transportul de valori impun monitorizarea GPS si dispecerizarea tuturor autovehiculelor care efectueaza acest tip de serviciu postal. Serviciile de dispecerizare si monitorizare a transportului de bunuri si valori monetare vor fi asigurate prin dispecerat autorizat de catre IGPR conform normelor legale in vigoare.(Legea 333/2003 si H.G. 301/2012, Cap.IV, art 55,56,61). Reglementarile legale nu permit transport de valori decat cu vehicule amenajate special, monitorizate GPS si dispecerizate prin dispecerat autorizat IGPR. Numarul de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor este de 18 zile. Entitatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificari sau informatiilor suplimentare in a 11-a zi inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor. Entitatea contractantă va răspunde la solicitările de clarificări adresate de operatorii economici până la termenul-limită stabilit. (cu respectarea art.173, alin.2 din Legea nr.99/2016).
